description:
[PAID] How overdue a draw one named team is, plus the results that made it so.

Returns the team's draw-likelihood rank and score among all ranked teams, the signals
behind it (draw rate, current no-draw streak, longest ever, draw debt), and its recent
form — every match in the current no-draw run, with opponent, score and side. Use this
when the question is about a specific team ("is Brazil due a draw?"); use predict_draws
when the question is about the field.

The prediction comes back null when the team exists but is not currently ranked (no
played matches, or excluded by the `recent` filter). Historical pattern, not a betting tip.

Costs 1 point per call (1 point = 1 cent); paginated calls cost 1 point per page.

recent.description: Rank within teams that have played recently, matching predict_draws. Default true.

team.description: Numeric team id or slug — 431 or "arsenal". Both come from list_teams.

wc2026.description: Rank within the 2026 World Cup team group. Default false.

name: get_team_prediction

prediction.description: The team's place in the ranking; null when it is not ranked (too few recent matches).

last_match_date.description: Date of the team's most recent match.

rank.description: Position in the ranking; 1 is the most overdue.

score.description: The draw-likelihood score the ranking sorts on.

signals.description: The figures the score is built from.

draw_debt.description: Draws expected from the draw rate minus draws that came.

draw_pct.description: Share of matches drawn, in percent.

max_no_draw_streak.description: Longest run without a draw, ever.

country.description: The country a team or competition belongs to.

exists_now.description: False for a team that no longer exists.

full_name.description: Official or long name, when known.

id.description: Team id — the argument every team tool takes.

slug.description: URL slug; accepted anywhere an id is.

recent_form.description: The team's latest results, newest first.
